title: Expressive Chicken
description: Expressive Chicken is a mod that adds new things with chicken.
body:
<details>
<summary>IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT</summary>


THIS MOD IS NO LONGER BEING UPDATED, I LOST THE PROJECT AND I'D RATHER NOT TRY AND RECREATE IT. IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN MORE MODS LIKE THIS CHECK OUT MY PROFILE SOON.

Expressive Chicken is a mod that adds new gameplay with chicken. Chicken can now be compressed and maybe can be used to travel..

Mod Includes
<details>
  <summary>Mod Content List</summary>
 
- Compressed Chicken (half set of building blocks)
  
- Cooked Compressed Chicken
  
- Chicken Igniter (portal igniter)
  
- Chicken Water (gives full saturation)
  
- Galinox Ore with armor and tools (next up from netherite)
  
- Chicken Dimension (regular portal with compressed chicken)

- 2 structures in Chicken Dimension

More content is soon to come
  
</details>


<details>
<summary>Operator Commands</summary>

/chickendimension - Teleports to the chicken dimension


</details>
